standardApplied: SSIS expression-language semantics and the documented meaning of DTSX-declared properties (errorRowDisposition, JoinType, precedence constraints, MaximumErrorCount) are treated as reading the files. Problem: the chain 'empty action type -> the cleaning turns it into NULL' is stated as a proven fact, but the files do not prove it. The Heir source has RetainNulls=false (DTSX:6643), so an empty field arrives as ""; Trim All Input Columns 1 FormatField returns null for "" (main.cs:53-57) and assigns it with p.SetValue(Row, null) (main.cs:45), which calls the generated setter 'set { this[8] = value; }' (DTSX:8565-8575). Whether assigning null through the ScriptBuffer indexer makes the column NULL is SSIS runtime behaviour that the files do not show (the same class of question as the getter on NULL that the package's other claims already label 'לא אומת').

In Move Folder To Archive the variable reads and the date-folder creation (94-102) are outside try; only the exists-check + Directory.Move are in try (104-110) and the catch sets TaskResult=Success (114). Problem: 'והמשימה ממשיכה' is stated as fact, but Convert Zips Main() never assigns Dts.TaskResult on any path (the only occurrence in the script is the template comment at ScriptMain.cs:93), so the task's result, after the empty catch and also on the normal path, is the Script Task's default TaskResult, which is not shown in the files. The same applies to Move Folder To Archive on its normal (no-exception) path: Dts.TaskResult is set only inside the catch. This is not mentioned, though it decides whether Get Heirs Folders runs at all (Success constraint DTSX:14523) and whether the loop continues after each folder.

results.id: L|Package\Foreach Loop Container\Create And Update Heir|detailed
results.detail: Verified: Heir source 12 columns, all RedirectRow -> Derived Column (no path); Contact source 5 columns (MACHOZ, MIS_TIK, MIS_BAKASHA, TAARICH_MATAN_ZAV_RASHAM->gen_issueanceofanorderdate, MIS_ZEHUT_MORISH->gen_customeridentitynumber), FailComponent; Merge Join inner, 3 keys, TreatNullsAsEqual=true; Set Heir Columns expressions and dispositions (status/name RedirectRow -> Derived Column 1; region FailComponent); Append Zeros (strip '.', left-pad '0' to column length 9); Format Dates (8 -> yyyy/MM/dd, 6 -> yyyy/MM/01, else null; TryParse); Lookups (Full cache, NoMatchBehavior=1); change empty strings to null (string DB columns only); IsEqual date compare obj1.Date == obj2.AddHours(3).Date; Create writes 16 attributes, only non-NULL; Update writes the 12 listed attributes; line-162 country bug; no outgoing paths from Create Heir. Problems: (1) Units 1, 3 and 5 state 'ערך ריק נחשב חסר' / empty action type becomes missing as fact. That depends on the null assignment via the generated setter (runtime, not in the files). (2) Unit 6 labels the getter-on-NULL question for IDs but not for the order date. An empty TAARICH_MATAN_ZAV_RASHAM becomes null in Trim All Input Columns, and Format Dates then reads it with p.GetValue (main.cs:45, getter Buffer.GetString). If that throws, Format Dates has no try/catch and the whole data flow fails, so 'תאריך לא תקין נחשב חסר' is not guaranteed for an empty date. The same applies to Append Zeros with a missing ID: no try/catch, so the outcome is a data-flow failure, not a row error, and the text does not say this. (3) Unit 20: for the status, Row.genstatus is Int32 (OptionSetValue(Row.genstatus), main.cs:192), so the getter cannot return an 'empty value'. If it does not throw, OptionSetValue(<int returned>) is sent, not a deletion. The conditional 'אם היא מחזירה ערך ריק, השדה נמחק ב-CRM' is therefore wrong for gen_status.
